summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GANOH Café Bistrô digital menu system for 2 stores. All core requirements successfully implemented and tested including payment methods, stock management, and gestor dashboard.
passed_tests: Store selector shows both stores (Runner and GYM Londres)
Menu pages display store-specific products correctly
Orders include payment_method field (PIX, Débito, Crédito, Dinheiro)
Kitchen page displays orders with payment methods visible
Gestor dashboard shows both stores with payment analytics
Stock management - products with quantities and low stock alerts
Products with stock=0 marked as unavailable in menu
Navigation between all pages works correctly
